lesson.title: 911 – Procedure 104: Out-of-Service & Visibility Patrol Codes
lesson.topic: Radio Code Signals – Out of Service & Visibility
objectives: Use out-of-service codes 10-61, 10-62, and 10-63 correctly with required explanations.
Explain the special rules for 10-71S (Sex Offender Housing address verification).
Differentiate visibility patrol 10-75 codes and their expansions.
Select the correct 10-75 code for various patrol and inspection scenarios.

questions.stem: Which statement BEST describes code 10-61 PRECINCT ASSIGNMENT?

choices.text: It is a regular call for service and does not need explanation.
It is NOT a call for service and MUST be documented with an explanation such as mail run, bank drop, prisoner’s meals, or 311 assignments.
It is only used when units go out for mechanical repairs.
It can be used as a generic final disposition.

questions.solution: Procedure 104 states that 10-61 is not a call for service and must be documented with an explanation like mail run, bank drop, prisoner meals, or 311 assignments.

questions.stem: Which 10-75 expansion is used when a unit leaves their RMP to walk and engage with community members in the area?

choices.text: 10-75C PARK, WALK & TALK PATROL / COMMUNITY TIME

questions.solution: Procedure 104 identifies 10-75C as PARK, WALK & TALK PATROL, also described as community time.

questions.stem: Code 10-62 OUT OF SERVICE (MECHANICAL) is ONLY used when the unit has mechanical problems.
For code 10-71S, the term 'Sex Offender' may be transmitted over the air if the caller is another MOS.
Code 10-63 MEAL must be transmitted with a __________ location provided by the field unit.
For code 10-71S ADDRESS VERIFICATION – SEX OFFENDER HOUSING, the guide states that the term __________ will NEVER be transmitted over the air.
Match each out-of-service code with its proper use.
answer: PRECINCT ASSIGNMENT – not a call for service; MUST be documented with explanation (mail run, bank drop, prisoner’s meals, 311 assignments).
OUT OF SERVICE (MECHANICAL) – ONLY when the unit has mechanical problems.
MEAL – must be transmitted with a meal location from the field unit.

questions.stem: Match each 10-75 visibility patrol expansion with its description.
answer: INTERIOR PATROL of multiple occupancy buildings (PLANNED patrol).
DIRECTED IN TRANSIT – BY NON-TRANSIT PD.
WARRANT CHECK – with routing (D, CW234, CWA, etc.).
